quran.note: Idris is called a man of truth and a prophet, and Allah raised him to a high station.
Ismail, Idris and Dhul-Kifl are named among the patient and the righteous.

hadith.summary: In the account of the Night Journey, the Prophet ﷺ names the prophets he met in each heaven, with Idris in the fourth. The report does not say that this is the “high station” of 19:57.
hadith.note: The link between the fourth heaven and 19:57 is made by Mujahid as quoted in Ibn Kathir; the hadith itself does not make it.

scholarly.work: Tafsir Ibn Kathir (abridged English edition, read on Quran.com)
scholarly.author: Ibn Kathir
scholarly.summary: Says Allah raised Idris to a high station. Quotes Mujahid (through Sufyan, from Mansur) that this is the fourth heaven, and al-Hasan and others that it is Paradise. He cites the Night Journey report of Idris in the fourth heaven.

differences.question: What is the “high station” of 19:57?
